# 06.20 Roadmap: Project Goal

## Project Goal

Create a Diagram as Code platform positioned between:

```text
PlantUML
      +
draw.io
      +
Cloudcraft
      +
Instana-style Topology
```

with a strong focus on:

- AWS Architecture Diagrams
- Network Topology Diagrams
- Infrastructure Documentation
- Diagram-Driven Development
- Shared generic 2D layout and routing across builtin, AWS, and UML profiles
- SVG / PPTX Export and Markdown SVG Embedding
